purpose: Verify that a canonical numeric concept ID can address local and ancestor-rooted relational information without copying inherited semantic triples into the canonical graph.
frozen_invariants: closure traversal is numeric and follows configured inheritance relation IDs
canonical semantic triple count is unchanged by closure materialization
inherited facts retain their original subject as origin_subject_id
parent facts are reachable at depth 1 and grandparent facts at depth 2
identical effective facts reachable from multiple hierarchy levels resolve to the nearest origin in the closure view
multiple child concepts may reference the same single stored ancestor fact
insertion-order reversal leaves the structural closure digest unchanged
inheritance cycles terminate without recursive expansion
non_claims: v0.45 does not assert that every ancestor relation is semantically inheritable
v0.45 does not create recursive macro IDs
v0.45 does not perform teacher ontology extraction
